title: Establish memory baseline: RSS under steady-state load
description:
Write a script (not a Rust benchmark) that starts transit + reader, runs 10,000 IHAVE ingestions and 10,000 ARTICLE fetches, and measures peak and steady-state RSS for both processes using /proc/PID/status. Artifact: scripts/mem_baseline.sh and results recorded in docs/perf_baseline.md.

Acceptance criteria:
- script is repeatable
- RSS recorded for transit and reader at: startup, after 1k articles, after 10k articles
- results committed as docs/perf_baseline.md
